task: Find Devin Booker's highest-scoring points per game playoff run.
agent_final_answer:
Devin Booker's highest-scoring points per game playoff run was during the **2022-23 NBA Playoffs**, in which he averaged **33.7 points per game** (across 11 games).

For reference, his playoff scoring averages by season on NBA.com are:
- **2022-23:** 33.7 PPG (11 GP)
- **2023-24:** 27.5 PPG (4 GP)
- **2020-21:** 27.3 PPG (22 GP)
- **2021-22:** 23.3 PPG (10 GP)
- **2025-26:** 21.3 PPG (4 GP)
